underlying_draw: The sensory thrill of treasure-hunting through an abundant market filled with meticulously packaged foods and discovering how each unexpected item tastes.
concepts: Timed evening markdowns and discount shopping
Japanese culinary presentation and packaging design
Sensory evaluation of texture, temperature, and flavor balance
Specialty ingredients (Wagyu, firefly squid, uni, dashi)
latent_skill: Sensory food critique and cultural market exploration
evidence: Mike methodically displays the multi-tier packaging of frozen dandan noodles, demonstrating how the tray keeps the broth separated from the noodles to preserve chewiness before mixing them together.
